metadata.title: Ordenanza Ministerial N° 23/025, Actualización de la Ordenanza 798/014 que crea el Sistema Nacional de Farmacovigilancia (Ministerio de Salud Pública)
metadata.edition: MSP normativa page dated 13/01/2025 (the text has no date line or entry-into-force clause; 13 January 2025 is a placeholder); replaces Ordenanza 798/014 · III.b laboratorios: every suspected event within 15 días hábiles of knowledge, mass-risk events announced within 24 hours; e-Reporting Industria the single route; responsible person and alternate resident in Uruguay (Spanish)
metadata.legal_basis: Ordenanza of the Ministerio de Salud Pública; the official Spanish text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
